_meta.beschreibung: Structured form of the template table (Knowledge Documents). Generated from the frontmatter of the mirrors under _content/promptotyping-document/ and from the function, file-name and type assignment in _content/konvention.md (template catalogue and routing heuristic). The order follows the template catalogue of the convention. The function names are English; template names remain stable identifiers. The trigger field carries the criterion under which a template applies.

schema.slug: URL anchor fragment, forming the site anchor together with #promptotyping-document-
schema.title: display name of the template
schema.funktion: function of the knowledge base that the template addresses (konvention.md, template catalogue)
schema.datei: recommended file name in the repository
schema.typ: analytical document type in short form, Declarative, Process or Action for declarative knowledge document, process knowledge document or agent instruction document, the three specialisations of the knowledge document by the kind of knowledge held (konvention.md, routing heuristic)
schema.machineUrl: static .md URL for machine retrieval without JavaScript
schema.trigger: condition under which the function of this template applies; taken from the function table in _content/konvention.md
schema.mark: short form of the trigger, shown as a mark beside the template on the start page

documents.title: Vorlage Index
documents.trigger: knowledge base has more than three documents or several constitutive terms

documents.title: Vorlage Specification
documents.funktion: Specification (formal requirements, epics and user stories, scope, decisions)

documents.title: Vorlage User Stories
documents.funktion: Specification (narrative usage scenarios in a separate file; documented exception only)

documents.title: Vorlage Architecture
documents.trigger: system goes beyond a static site

documents.title: Vorlage Technology
documents.funktion: Technology Baseline (rules and rationale for a whole artefact family, held centrally)
documents.trigger: several projects build the same artefact type and the stack rationale is reusable

documents.title: Vorlage Domaenenwissen
documents.funktion: Domain Knowledge (rationale layer and domain rule set)
documents.trigger: research, edition or data project with a domain-methodological prescriptive or theoretical layer

documents.title: Vorlage Testing
documents.trigger: project with tests, verification or acceptance checks

documents.title: Vorlage Verification
documents.funktion: Verification (adversarial checking of a project's own claims against the raw data)
documents.trigger: project makes empirical findings or novelty claims that are used externally (paper, report, handover)

documents.title: Vorlage Plan
documents.trigger: project with phases, milestones or sprint control

documents.title: Vorlage Report
documents.trigger: project status report for an external recipient (client, funder, stakeholder); the normal case in commissioned projects

documents.title: Vorlage Integration
documents.trigger: project with a durable cross-project contract for data, formats or responsibilities
